look_here_first: Start with the perennial tuft and the contracted panicle. Rough dropseed is a perennial bunchgrass with a narrow, tight panicle and rough-textured spikelets; unlike annual poverty dropseed, it persists from year to year and lacks hidden sheath cleistogenes as the main ID feature.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Purola Preserve natural flora; Travis and Williamson — county distribution layer explicitly records both counties.
